description: This file defines functions for notifying telemetry events via a command-line client, including functions for counting notifications and value notifications, with license and copyright information.

methods.name: t2CountNotify
methods.description: Sends a count notification to the telemetry client if it exists.

methods.name: t2ValNotify
methods.description: Sends a value notification with additional parameters to the telemetry client if it exists.
